title: Ardipithecus ramidus and the skeleton "Ardi", Ethiopia
summary: In October 2009 a team co-led by Tim White published a set of papers in Science on Ardipithecus ramidus, reporting over 110 specimens including a partial skeleton of a female nicknamed Ardi. She lived 4.4 million years ago in what is now the Afar region of Ethiopia, within the Middle Awash Valley area where the team works.

uncertainty.note: Years before present in the sources are written here as negative calendar years without subtracting 1950; the sources give rounded ages. Both sources give 4.4 million years without an error range. The papers appeared in the 2 October 2009 issue of Science.
